common_acceptance.criterion: The positive uses the installed workflow and relevant named native roles. Discovery, source-body reads and actual role dispatch are supported separately by host events; a generic child reading role text is a labeled fallback.
common_acceptance.evidence: Installed closure/source digest; config and skills/list preflight; thread parent/agentRole and delegation/read event locators.

common_acceptance.criterion: Coordinator assigns one writer for the candidate procedure, freezes its digest, and obtains independent findings covering continuation and platform/deadline questions. Findings return to that owner; material correction is followed by affected checks and focused re-review. Main session may be the owner; no extra coordinator layer or fixed roster is required.
common_acceptance.evidence: Path assignment, stable procedure digest, distinct reviewer identity/assignment, candidate-bound findings, owner correction and re-review chain. Self-review and final prose alone are insufficient.

common_acceptance.criterion: Only declared procedure and new coordination/review output paths change; all supplied contracts, source excerpts, data, observer and installed closure stay intact. Trial identity is bound to unique scenario ID, fixture-index/raw hashes and candidate source digest. No live service is contacted.
common_acceptance.evidence: Prepared baseline/final hashes, workspace diff, unique scenario manifest binding, exact commands and absence of external mutations; capability limitations remain separate.

common_acceptance.criterion: Distinguishes synthetic artifact arithmetic, procedure preparation, actual native host behavior and unexecuted platform/runtime durability checks. Process completion and observer exit zero are not acceptance proof.
common_acceptance.evidence: Local command output, host terminal/events and precise final validation limits.

cases.user_mode: planning artifact implementation; no worker/runtime code changes

acceptance.criterion: Explains the same accepted export reaching business failure counts 1,2,3 after A/B/C retirements and the third dead-letter; uses the specified maintenance disposition while preserving exactly three genuine failures for malformed input. Merely raising the failure limit or exempting every exception is insufficient.
acceptance.evidence: Named journal events and counter arithmetic; operator/API procedure; poison control oracle.

acceptance.criterion: Closes queue receive and buffered handler admission, covers a receive begun before closure and already claimed work, and keeps ownership/progress responsibility explicit until safe defer or bounded unresolved recovery. Readiness, PDB or empty latest poll alone is insufficient.
acceptance.evidence: signal-prefetch timestamps/IDs, buffer count, pending claim disposition and one authoritative drain entry transition.

acceptance.criterion: Uses current ownership epoch/lease enforcement at each protected progress/effect/finish transaction, stable operation identities and epoch-conditional renew/release. Paused generation 41 cannot overwrite generation 42 progress or clear its claim; expiry or a pre-write read alone is insufficient.
acceptance.evidence: pause-resume schedule, unsafe save_progress excerpt and specified atomic API; no cursor/effect regression oracle.

acceptance.criterion: Treats lost checkpoint/finish/defer responses as unknown, resolves durable operations under stable IDs and resumes only from confirmed progress with replay-safe effects. Final receipt-before-completion-ACK and completed-redelivery handling survive ACK loss.
acceptance.evidence: checkpoint-reply-loss and final-ack-loss observations; inspect/receipt decisions; one final receipt and unique logical batch/result oracle.

acceptance.criterion: Distinguishes r8 reading format 2 from r7 reading format 3; default r8 writes can close the r7 rollback/claim path. Gates write format/eligible claims or provides demonstrated compatibility and a feasible forward recovery path; retains required v2 inputs/layout until no unfinished job needs them. Does not claim new-job smoke proves old continuation.
acceptance.evidence: Image read/write matrix, nonterminal job checkpoint formats, routing/retention release conditions and compatibility checks.

acceptance.criterion: Accounts for 15 seconds preStop inside 90 seconds, leaving at most75 for application work with exit margin; 85-second wait cannot fit. Successor capacity/compatibility, hold/escalation rules and accountable old-work retirement/release evidence are concrete. Readiness or rollout completion does not establish business completion.
acceptance.evidence: Budget arithmetic, capacity sequence and hold/stop gates; operational retirement assignment distinct from per-job execution epoch.

acceptance.criterion: Proposes checks of repeated maintenance and genuine poison failures, receive/prefetch race, uncertain checkpoint/receipt, pause/takeover/resume, mixed-version continuation and forced deadline with independent output/progress/counter oracles. Local observe.py output is reported only as supplied-artifact arithmetic.
acceptance.evidence: Candidate check table or procedure, observer command/stdout and unexecuted real checks.

cases.verification_limit: Observer/output command does not grade the procedure or prove runtime/platform behavior; independent scoring required.
